name: logline
description: Logline: bets on the line, settled by the logs. Prediction markets on on-chain metrics, on NEAR.

scripts.contract:deploy: cd contract && cargo near deploy build-non-reproducible-wasm --env "RUSTFLAGS=-C link-arg=-s --remap-path-prefix=$HOME=~" $CONTRACT_ID without-init-call network-config testnet sign-with-legacy-keychain send
scripts.contract:deploy:mainnet: cd contract && cargo near deploy build-non-reproducible-wasm --env "RUSTFLAGS=-C link-arg=-s --remap-path-prefix=$HOME=~" loglines.near with-init-call new json-args '{"owner":"loglines.near","resolver":"resolver.loglines.near","token":"17208628f84f5d6ad33f0da3bbbeb27ffcb398eac501a31bd6ad2011e36133a1","decimals":6}' prepaid-gas '100.0 Tgas' attached-deposit '0 NEAR' network-config mainnet sign-with-legacy-keychain send
scripts.contract:wasm: cd contract && cargo near build non-reproducible-wasm --env "RUSTFLAGS=-C link-arg=-s --remap-path-prefix=$HOME=~" && cp target/near/logline.wasm res/logline.wasm && shasum -a 256 res/logline.wasm
